description: This Java source file defines the class ModifyAttribute, which represents a command to modify an attribute of a 'thing' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, validating input, and serializing the command. The class is part of the 'modify' package for handling attribute modification commands.

classes.name: ModifyAttribute
classes.description: Represents a command to modify a specific attribute of a thing, including the attribute's JSON pointer and new value, with methods for creation, validation, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a ModifyAttribute command given a ThingId, attribute pointer, attribute value, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ModifyAttribute command from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer of the attribute to modify.

methods.name: getAttributeValue
methods.description: Returns the new value for the attribute.
